method: Fill in ROOM DESCRIPTION, describe the person or people from a photo you are authorized to upload, and choose the action, expression and lighting atmosphere. The third source example shows two figurines; that is an observed variation, and the singular source wording does not guarantee a pair or a romantic relationship.

variants.label: Miniature character room diorama
variants.promptText: An isometric 3D cube-shaped miniature room (shallow cutaway true cube; everything strictly contained within the cube). The room is [ROOM DESCRIPTION: Describe the theme, furniture, specific clutter, wall decorations, and key items in detail]. Character: a chibi/figurine-style — [INSERT DESCRIPTION OF THE PERSON FROM YOUR UPLOADED PHOTO HERE]. The character is [ACTION: e.g., sitting on a chair typing, standing and cooking, playing guitar], with a [EXPRESSION: e.g., focused, happy, smiling] expression. Figure material looks like matte PVC, with big head / small body proportions. Lighting: [ATMOSPHERE NAME]: [LIGHT SOURCES: e.g., neon blue glow, warm sunlight, golden lamp light]; realistic reflections and colored shadows. Camera: slightly elevated isometric three-quarter view, front cube edge centered; no elements protruding outside the cube. Photoreal materials with fine detail; neutral backdrop. Ultra-detailed, clean composition; no watermark.

purpose: Create a miniature cube room that stages a character and their activity.
summary: A cube-shaped isometric room contains a stylized figurine, detailed props and a chosen lighting atmosphere.
title: Miniature character room diorama

variables.name: Room description
variables.value: Describe the room theme, furniture, clutter, wall decorations and key items.

variables.name: Character
variables.value: Describe a person from a photo you are authorized to upload.

variables.name: Action
variables.value: State what the figurine is doing in the room.

variables.name: Lighting atmosphere
variables.value: Name the atmosphere and light sources.
